info.name: Data Enrichment AI Intelligence Platform
info.description:
# Data Enrichment AI Intelligence Platform API Collection

Production Postman collection for validating, testing, and demonstrating the 5-microservice **Data Enrichment AI Intelligence Platform**.

## Microservices Architecture & Ports
- **api-gateway** (`{{gatewayBaseUrl}}` default `:9738` / `:8080`): Public entrypoint, JWT Bearer verification, anti-spoofing.
- **auth-service** (`{{authBaseUrl}}` default `:9739`): User registration, BCrypt credential hashing, HMAC-SHA256 JWT tokens.
- **dataset-service** (`{{datasetBaseUrl}}` default `:9743`): Tabular parsing, schema profiling, bounded async workers (3), SSE streaming, MySQL user-isolated persistence.
- **research-service** (`{{researchBaseUrl}}` default `:9741`): Multi-source web discovery, crawling, scraping guardrails, evidence corroboration.
- **ai-intelligent-service** (`{{aiBaseUrl}}` default `:9742`): Requirement interpretation, input cleansing, grounded fact extraction (Spring AI + Gemini Flash).
